en.name: Portfolio Board
en.subtitle: Offline spec and stage board
en.short_description: Browse 33 bundled project specs offline and track the stage each one is at.
en.description:
Portfolio Board is an offline reader and stage tracker for the American Group LLC project portfolio: 28 candidate projects and 5 shared-infrastructure specs, with all 198 of their specification documents bundled inside the app.

The Portfolio tab groups every record into the categories the roadmap defines, shows the stage spread as a bar, and lets you tap a stage to see exactly which records sit in it. Browse searches every word of all 198 documents, counts the matches per document, shows a verbatim snippet, and opens that document with the term highlighted. Results can be narrowed by category, stage, priority tier (T1 to T4), spec depth and record kind.

Health is the portfolio summary: where records stand now against where the source documents put them, the Tier-1 greenlight gate rollup (criteria met, LOIs signed, gates cleared), the count of full, thin and stub specs together with the measured rule behind those labels, category coverage thinnest first, and which records have gone longest untouched.

Each project opens on a tracking tab plus one tab per document - README, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, ROADMAP, COMPETITIVE and GO-TO-MARKET, or INTEGRATION for shared infrastructure. The tracking tab carries the project's portfolio-table facts, its ten-axis priority score axis by axis, its greenlight gate criteria, an index of its documents, and its stage history. Moving a project between stages takes a bottom sheet and an optional note explaining why.

Documents render as markdown with real tables, so competitor matrices and score grids stay readable. Mermaid and ASCII diagrams are shown as labelled source rather than redrawn as pictures the app cannot honestly draw.

What it does not do. Everything shown comes from one snapshot of the roadmap tree compiled into the build, so there is no network, no sync, no account and no sign-in. You cannot add projects or edit the specifications; the set of records is fixed until a new build ships. Stage moves and their notes are stored on your device only, are never written back to the documents, and can be cleared from Settings to return the board to what the documents say. The screens and the bundled documents are in English.
en.promotional_text: Every roadmap document for 33 portfolio records, bundled offline: full-text search, spec-depth and gate health, and a stage board you keep on your device.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Portfolio Board is an offline reader and stage tracker for the American Group LLC project portfolio: 28 candidate projects and 5 shared-infrastructure specs, with all 198 of their specification documents bundled inside the app.

Intended audience:
Offline spec and stage board

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None. The app works entirely on the device and calls no external service.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
